title: Vintage Le Creuset Cast Iron Skillet – White Enamel – Size 20
description:
Beautiful vintage Le Creuset cast iron skillet in a rare and elegant white enamel finish. A charming French-made piece, both practical and highly decorative, perfect for collectors of vintage Le Creuset cookware or for everyday cooking and serving.
This skillet features the classic Le Creuset quality with a smooth enamel interior and timeless design. The white color is much harder to find than the traditional shades, making this piece especially desirable.
Marked “Le Creuset – Made in France” and size 20 on the underside.
Approximate dimensions:
• Diameter: 20 cm
• Height: around 4.5 cm
Condition: very good vintage condition overall, with light signs of use consistent with age. The enamel remains glossy and clean. Please check pictures carefully, as all my items are vintage pieces and may show small traces of time and use.
A lovely rare addition for a Le Creuset collection, French country kitchen decor, or everyday cooking with authentic vintage cast iron.
